The passengers are seated closely together, all focused on their personal electronic devices, primarily smartphones. In the foreground, there are two individuals who stand out due to their expressions and the way they are holding their phones. The person on the left has short dark hair and is wearing white earbuds. They appear to be looking at their phone with a concerned or worried expression.
